title: Accurate Rabbit Eyes
description: Moves the new 26.1+ rabbits' eyes to the sides of their head for a more anatomically accurate look.
body:
Moves the new 26.1+ rabbits' eyes to the sides of their head for a more anatomically accurate look.

![A white Minecraft rabbit. Its eyes have been moved from the front of its head to the side of its head compared to the vanilla appearance.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5162315369718b4a327110cb6f90ac85462f7eba.png)

(The Killer Rabbit retains its forward facing eyes. That is a predator on the hunt. It's only fitting.)
